The '''Byss shipyards''' were [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] in operation at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Byss/Legends|Byss]].<ref name="DES" /> During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] operated these Class IA shipyards to build [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]] and [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]].<ref name="TeGTW" /> After the death of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] and his subsequent resurrection on Byss, the shipyards were assigned to the production of massive battlestations and warships such as the [[Galaxy Gun]], the [[Eclipse-class dreadnought|''Eclipse''-class dreadnoughts]], the [[Sovereign-class Super Star Destroyer|''Sovereign''-class Super Star Destroyers]],<ref name="BatDC">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050414planet1|series=Byss and the Deep Core|text=Part 1: Byss}}</ref> and the [[World Devastator]]s used by the [[Dark Empire]] against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] during [[Operation Shadow Hand]].<ref name="FF98">{{FactFile|98|MON 1-4|Battle of Mon Calamari}}</ref>
